data.name: GigaDAC
data.description: GigaDAC (legal name Victory Over Carbon Inc.) is a Houston-based direct air capture startup founded in 2022, spun out of Rice University and incubated at Greentown Labs Houston. The company is developing a spray-based DAC process using aerospace engineering principles, targeting costs below $90/ton, and was building a commercial-scale pilot for 2025. Backed by the NSF and Greentown Labs.
